summary: Top of the bracket: ranged burst plus a pet and strong survivability; frequently called the strongest 10-19 class.
factionNotes: Alliance hunters get green-or-better ammo pouches (Quiver / Bandolier of the Night Watch); Horde hunters lack green+ pouches, a real mechanical disadvantage. Pets need ~25% of player XP and gain none from quest turn-ins, so sync pets before turning in gear quests.
